title: Engine Protocol v1
description: Newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) wire between the trusted benchmarker and an untrusted inference engine, over stdio (co-located) or localhost TCP (via bench-agent / compose network). Every line is exactly one WorkerRequest or one WorkerResponse. Ported from the Swift RuntimeWorkerRequest / RuntimeWorkerResponse Codable structs (Sources/MLXFastHarness/QwenRuntimeWorker.swift) plus the Phase-0 hello handshake fields (docs/architecture.md §3).

WorkerRequest.description: Benchmarker -> engine. Ported from Swift RuntimeWorkerRequest. `id` correlates the response; `kind` selects the message. Optional fields are present only for the kinds that use them and are OMITTED (not null) when unused, matching Swift's encodeIfPresent.

id.description: Monotonic request id echoed back on the response. 64-bit signed.

prompt_tokens.description: Prompt token IDs. Used by prefill, correctness, correctness_begin.

token.description: Single input token ID. Used by decode_step and correctness_step.

seed_tokens.description: Whole-prompt seed token IDs for the single charged seed forward. Used by decode_begin.

steps.description: Number of free-run greedy steps. Used by correctness.

count.description: NEW in v1.1 (additive). Number of committed tokens N the engine must free-run and return. Used by free_decode_run. Appended last; a v1-only request omits it.

spec.description: Wire-additive (docs/spec-config-design.md). Per-module speculative configuration for the timed decode window. Carried on decode_begin / free_decode_begin; absent means the engine default. Appended last; a pre-spec request omits it.

seed_tokens_by_stream.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). Per-stream seed token IDs for a batched free_decode_begin: B inner arrays, one per cohort slot, in SLOT ORDER. The single-stream v1.1 form uses seed_tokens instead; a request carries one or the other, never both. Appended last; a pre-v1.2 request omits it.

batch_size.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). The explicit cohort width B, carried on free_decode_begin and free_decode_run. Never inferred from an array length; the engine must echo it as effective_batch_size and benchd rejects a divergent echo fail-closed. Presence selects the cohort form of the verb. Appended last.

replay_seeds_by_stream.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #35). Per-stream SEED token lists for a cohort_reference_replay: B inner arrays in SLOT ORDER. A dedicated field distinct from seed_tokens_by_stream; the trusted oracle replays teacher-forced and needs each stream's seed context. Rides only on cohort_reference_replay. Appended last.

committed_by_stream.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #35). The candidate's COMMITTED token journals to replay teacher-forced: B inner arrays in SLOT ORDER, with committed_by_stream.length == replay_seeds_by_stream.length. Rides only on cohort_reference_replay. Appended last.

logit_top_k.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #35). The oracle's logit top-K depth (engine default 16). Audit-only under (b); benchd consumes only sequential_argmax. Appended last.

rel_envelope.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #35). The oracle's relative-envelope threshold (engine default 0.05). Audit-only under (b). Appended last.

replay_width.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #37). The reference's replay WIDTH for cohort_reference_replay: 'cohort' replays the B streams batched at the scored candidate's geometry, 'canonical' is the per-stream width-1 diagnostic. The engine refuses any other value. benchd always sends 'cohort' explicitly rather than inheriting the engine-side default: the enforced reference geometry is pinned by the request. Rides only on cohort_reference_replay. Appended last.

WorkerResponse.description: Engine -> benchmarker. Ported from Swift RuntimeWorkerResponse. `id` echoes the request (-1 for a response to an unparseable line); `ok` is the success flag. Optional fields are present only for the kinds that produce them and are OMITTED (not null) when unused, matching Swift's encodeIfPresent. protocol_version / backend / device are new in v1 and meaningful only on the hello (id=0) message.

id.description: Echoes the request id; -1 when the request line could not be parsed.

nonce.description: Per-session nonce established on the hello; echoed on every subsequent response and validated by the parent.

ok.description: True on success. On false the session for that phase is discarded.

error.description: Human-readable error string, present only when ok is false.

token.description: Materialized output token ID. Produced by prefill, decode_step, correctness_begin, correctness_step.

top_logits.description: Top-K (K=8) logits for the teacher-forced anchor gate. Produced by correctness_begin / correctness_step.

seed_token.description: Token from the single seed forward. Produced by decode_begin.

tokens.description: Free-run greedy token IDs. Produced by correctness.

expert_stats.description: Expert-streaming counters. Produced by hello, correctness_begin, correctness_step, phase_diagnostics (NOT plain correctness, which returns only tokens + peak_ram_gb — see PROTOCOL.md). Zeroed for the RAM-resident dense runtime.

peak_ram_gb.description: Peak resident set size in GB, engine-reported and distrusted for scoring. Produced by correctness, correctness_begin, correctness_step, phase_diagnostics.

protocol_version.description: NEW in v1. Engine's implemented protocol version (currently 1). Meaningful only on the hello.

backend.description: NEW in v1. Compute backend, e.g. "mlx" or "cuda". Meaningful only on the hello.

device.description: NEW in v1. Device identity, e.g. "m5" or "gb10". Meaningful only on the hello.

completed_work.description: NEW in v1. Monotonic count of timed step-requests the engine completed in the current phase, reported on phase_diagnostics. The parent fails the run if it does not equal the number of timed steps it issued (architecture §3, phase-close barrier).

cache_memory.description: NEW in v1 (#54). MLX allocator free-buffer cache size in bytes at the phase boundary, mirroring Swift Memory.cacheMemory in resetRuntimeWorkerAllocatorForPhaseStart. Reported on phase_diagnostics; the parent fails the run CLOSED unless it is exactly 0 (Swift's fail-closed drain postcondition). Appended last, back-compat: absent means not asserted; present must be 0.

capabilities.description: NEW in v1.1 (additive). Capability flags the engine advertises, meaningful only on the hello. Carries "free_run_decode" for an engine implementing the oracle-verified free-run timed decode mode. Appended last; a v1-only engine omits it.

acceptance_lengths.description: NEW in v1.1 (additive). Per verify-round committed count from free_decode_run; length is the round count R. AUDIT-only (never scored), persisted verbatim and cross-checked by the §2.6 consistency triple.

drafted_total.description: NEW in v1.1 (additive). Total draft tokens proposed across all free_decode_run rounds (>= accepted_total; fallback position counts as drafted). AUDIT-only, self-reported.

accepted_total.description: NEW in v1.1 (additive). Total drafts that passed internal verification and were committed. AUDIT-only, self-reported and distrusted for scoring.

committed_total.description: NEW in v1.1 (additive). Total committed tokens from free_decode_run; MUST equal N and tokens.len(). Externally anchored by benchd's exact-match verification.

effective_spec.description: Wire-additive (docs/spec-config-design.md). The module-parsed, default-filled speculative config the engine will actually run, echoed on the decode_begin / free_decode_begin response. benchd seals only this echo and rejects a leg whose echo diverges from the request. Appended last; a pre-spec engine omits it.

spec_modes.description: Wire-additive (docs/spec-config-design.md). The runnable speculative modes the engine advertises, meaningful only on the hello. Stub modules are not listed. Appended last; a pre-spec engine omits it.

head_provenance.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). The engine's loaded-head provenance (sha256 + byte size + shard file count), emitted on the hello. MODELED so benchd stops rejecting the real engine line under the closed envelope; AUDIT-only. Appended last; a pre-#106 engine omits it.

mlx_active_memory_bytes.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). MLX allocator ACTIVE (in-use) memory in bytes, read PRE-DRAIN on phase_diagnostics (distinct from the POST-drain cache_memory). AUDIT-only. Appended last.

mlx_cache_memory_bytes.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). MLX allocator free-buffer CACHE memory in bytes, read PRE-DRAIN on phase_diagnostics. Distinct from the post-drain cache_memory (which must be 0 after the drain). AUDIT-only.

mlx_peak_memory_bytes.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). MLX allocator PEAK memory watermark in bytes, read PRE-DRAIN on phase_diagnostics. AUDIT-only. Appended last.

top_logit_margin.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). The ALWAYS-present top-logit margin (gap between the top and second logit) on the correctness_* teacher-forced steps. AUDIT-only. Appended last.

expected_token_logit.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). The CONDITIONAL logit of the expected (teacher-forced) token on the correctness_* steps; present only when there is an expected token. AUDIT-only.

expected_token_rank.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). The CONDITIONAL rank of the expected token in the engine's logit ordering on the correctness_* steps; present only alongside expected_token_logit. AUDIT-only. Appended last.

spec_decoder.description: Decoder-neutral spec-decode abstraction (additive). The name of the speculative decoder that produced this round's data (e.g. mtp / dflash / dspark), emitted on the free_decode_run response so per-round data is self-describing about which decoder generated it, independent of the request's spec.mode. AUDIT-only, never scored. Appended last; an engine that omits it round-trips unchanged.

max_batch_size.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). The largest cohort width B the engine can serve, advertised on the hello, so benchd can refuse an over-wide cohort pre-GPU. Absent means not advertised. Appended last.

seed_token_by_stream.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). The B seed-forward token IDs from a batched free_decode_begin, one per cohort slot in SLOT ORDER, each oracle-checked against that slot's expected seed token. The single-stream v1.1 form uses seed_token instead.

effective_batch_size.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). The cohort width the engine will actually run, echoed on free_decode_begin / free_decode_run. NEVER-IGNORED like effective_spec: benchd compares it to the requested batch_size and discards the leg fail-closed on divergence.

tokens_by_stream.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). Committed token IDs from a batched free_decode_run: B inner arrays of N tokens each, in SLOT ORDER, every token exact-matched benchd-side against that slot's golden continuation. Replaces (never accompanies) tokens in the cohort form.

natural_accepted_by_stream.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). Each row's PRE-min natural accept-walk length per round: B inner arrays of R counts, in SLOT ORDER. AUDIT-only, never scored. The cohort commits one common width per round (the min across rows), so this is what makes straggler throttling visible instead of silently folded into the committed width.

rounds.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). The round count R the engine ran. Redundant with acceptance_lengths.len() by design; benchd cross-checks the two and refuses a response that disagrees with itself.

active_streams_by_round.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). Number of streams still generating at each round, length R. Under the closed fixed-N cohort policy this must be non-increasing. AUDIT-only, never scored.

depth_clamp_reasons.description: NEW in v1.2 (additive, COHORT). Histogram of the engine's depth-clamp reasons over the window (e.g. automatic_rectangular_limit, tail_depth, batch_gate, step_kv_headroom, rectangular_cache_unsupported). AUDIT-only, never scored, sealed verbatim; this is what makes 'did it actually speculate?' checkable rather than trusted.

prefill_ns_by_stream.description: Per-stream timing instrumentation (per-stream-instrumentation-spec.md step 1, additive COHORT). Per-slot monotonic nanoseconds from cohort-prefill start to that slot's seed commit, one per cohort slot in SLOT ORDER, on a batched free_decode_begin response. Gated by the per_stream_timing hello capability. RAW engine clock reads only; UNTRUSTED for scoring until benchd's attestation admits them. Currently REPORT-ONLY.

decode_ns_by_stream.description: Per-stream timing instrumentation (per-stream-instrumentation-spec.md step 1, additive COHORT). Per-slot monotonic nanoseconds from decode-phase start to that slot's final-token commit, one per cohort slot in SLOT ORDER, on a batched free_decode_run response. Same capability gate and untrusted-until-attested posture as prefill_ns_by_stream.

cohort_reference_replay.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #35). The TRUSTED oracle's cohort_reference_replay report: the per-stream reference argmax for each replayed position. Present only on a cohort_reference_replay response. benchd consumes committed_token (N2 echo integrity) and sequential_argmax (the reference argmax for the <=10% per-stream tolerance gate). Appended last.

CohortReferenceReplayReport.description: (b) admission (engine #35). The trusted oracle's per-stream reference-argmax report. Not additionalProperties:false: the engine may emit a richer audit payload than (b) reads; the two load-bearing position fields (committed_token, sequential_argmax) are required.

logit_topk.description: Logit top-K the oracle ran. Audit-only.

rel_envelope.description: Relative envelope the oracle ran. Audit-only.

replay_width.description: NEW in (b) admission (engine #37). The replay WIDTH the oracle actually ran at, echoed back. NOT audit-only: when present benchd asserts it against the width the request pinned, fail-closed. Absent on an engine that does not yet stamp it; the assertion is presence-conditioned and arms itself when the stamp lands.

streams.description: Per-stream replay results, in SLOT ORDER.

CohortReferenceReplayStream.description: (b) admission. One cohort stream's replay results: its slot index plus per-position reference data.

slot.description: The cohort slot this stream occupies (SLOT ORDER identity).

CohortReferenceReplayPosition.description: (b) admission. One replayed position's reference data. committed_token + sequential_argmax are required (the two fields (b) consumes); everything else is audit-only. NOT additionalProperties:false: a richer engine payload must decode without failing.

committed_token.description: The candidate's committed token the oracle replayed, echoed back. benchd verifies this equals the candidate's own tokens_by_stream (byte/id) BEFORE counting mismatches (N2).

sequential_argmax.description: The reference argmax at this position (== ranked_tokens[0]) — the reference token the committed token is compared against for the <=10% per-stream tolerance gate.

SpecConfig.description: Per-module speculative configuration (docs/spec-config-design.md). Exactly one mode; the per-mode block is nested under the mode key. serial carries no block. Depth is a module field (mtp.depth), never a top-level flag.

mtp.description: The mtp module block; present only when mode is mtp.

dflash.description: The dflash module block; opaque to benchd, present only when mode is dflash.

dspark.description: The dspark module block; opaque to benchd (reserved), present only when mode is dspark.

MtpSpec.description: The mtp module config block. Depth is the module's field; benchd carries it and bounds-checks it against the anti-DDoS cap before spawning.

depth.description: The MTP draft depth the module runs.

HeadProvenance.description: NEW in #106 (passthrough MODEL). The engine's loaded-head provenance emitted on the hello: the sha256 of the head bytes the engine loaded, the total on-disk byte size, and the shard file count. All three are required inside the object; AUDIT/provenance only (never scored).

sha256.description: Sha256 of the head bytes the engine loaded.

bytes.description: Total on-disk byte size of the head.

file_count.description: Number of shard files comprising the head.

CorrectnessTraceLogit.description: Ported from Swift CorrectnessTraceLogit (Sources/MLXFastHarness/QwenRuntime.swift). No CodingKeys, so JSON keys are literally token/logit.

ExpertStreamingStats.description: Ported from Swift ExpertStreamingStats (Sources/MLXFastCore/ExpertStreamingStats.swift). All fields required; the dense RAM-resident runtime reports the zero struct.
